name: AUTOPILOT.OI Bill Agent
description_html:
Check a medical bill before you pay it.

Compares your itemized bill with your insurance statement, points out charges that don't match, writes your call script and keeps a list of every bill until it's settled.

What you get: a Claude prompt kit (PDF): the master prompt, 5 starter prompts, a 10 minute setup guide and a tracker.

How it works: you paste the prompt into a Claude Project and run it whenever you need it. It reads what you upload and drafts. You check it, decide and send. It does not call anyone, see your insurance account or guarantee a lower bill on its own.

You need: a Claude account (the free plan works, up to 5 Projects) and your itemized bill and your insurer's explanation of benefits.

Education only, not financial, legal or medical advice. AUTOPILOT.OI is independent and not affiliated with Anthropic.
